fiji.definition: n. an independent state within the British Commonwealth located on the Fiji Islands
fiji.translation: n. 斐济(西太平洋), 斐济语, 斐济人

fiji dollar.translation: 斐济元（斐济群岛共和国货币单位）

fiji islands.translation: 斐济群岛（南太平洋群岛名）

fijian.definition:
n. a native or inhabitant of Fiji
n. the Oceanic language spoken on Fiji
a. of or relating to Fiji or its people or language or culture
fijian.translation:
n. 斐济人, 斐济语
a. 斐济的

fijians.definition:
plural of Fijian
n. a native or inhabitant of Fiji
n. the Oceanic language spoken on Fiji
a. of or relating to Fiji or its people or language or culture
fijians.translation:
(Fijian 的复数) n. 斐济人, 斐济语
a. 斐济的

fijis.translation: 斐济[太平洋西南部斐济群岛(Fiji Islands)上的岛国,在新西兰之北;首都苏瓦,全称 the Republic of the Fiji Islands斐济群岛共和国]
